notes.title: Bugfixes and Improvments
notes.notes:
-Shorten the Time for restarting and going in the Main Menu
-Hides the mouse during Gameplay
-Cap the fps for more efficente use and less weird Bugs.
-Added a windowname
-After some feedback from player is it now easier to go from the Gamesettingsmenu in the main game
-Removed the flickering screen issue for some players.
The linux Version is still in development and should be pushed be eather the next or after that update.

notes.title: Day One Patch
notes.notes:
-Fixed a game-breaking bug.
-Addressed various bugs related to the tongue functionality.
-Fixed a bug where the tongue sound played even when the player was the fly.
-Enlarged the colliders for the fly.
-The quit button in the pause menu now works as intended and no longer removes frogs from the game when they rejoin.
